request: 请修改导出下载功能：已批准把文件可下载期限从 7 天缩短为 24 小时，以减少敏感文件的暴露时间；到创建后恰好 24 小时就应返回 410 且不提供 URL，之前仍返回 200 和 URL。审计记录仍保留 30 天。完成实现与必要验证。

files.README.md:
# Export service

Small standard-library Python service.

Run checks: `python -m unittest discover -s tests -v`

See [project information](docs/index.md).
files.docs/reference/download.md:
# Download contract

Downloads remain available for 7 days after creation. At exactly 7 days they are still available; after that, return HTTP 410 with no URL. Available downloads return HTTP 200 and the stored URL.
files.docs/architecture/lifecycle.md:
# Artifact lifecycle

Download artifacts expire after 7 days. Audit records remain available for 30 days.

```mermaid
stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Available
    Available --> Expired: age > 7 days
    Expired --> [*]: download returns 410
```
files.docs/decisions/0001-retention.md:
# ADR-0001 Seven-day artifact retention

Status: Accepted

Support users sometimes retrieve exports several days later. We chose seven days rather than one day to reduce regeneration requests. Audit records are retained separately for 30 days.
files.docs/operations/audit.md:
# Audit operations

Audit records remain for 30 days for incident investigation. Artifact expiry does not delete audit records.
